title: Resonate Gem Brain
tagline: A GitHub-first pattern for making Google Gems behave like an agentic system without extra code.
stateNote: A small pattern repository, last changed in August 2025.
problem: Gem instructions get messy. This repo keeps them composable and versioned: a Gem reads AGENTS.md, which delegates through a manifest to one primary agent.
audience: People building Gems or similar instruction-driven assistants.
contribution: It is my project: the manifest, agent files, guardrails and examples.
worksToday: The README describes attaching the repo as a Source and instructing the Gem to read AGENTS.md first.
limitations: I haven't tested it in a Gem.

involve.headline: Built Gems?
asks: If you've tried something similar, I'd like to compare notes.
